concept: Recognizing manipulation tactics (guilt-tripping, gaslighting, love-bombing) before they take hold
source_inspiration: original content, informed by Odysseus's strategic-cunning tradition — not sourced from any external text

exercise.scenario: Student is presented with a realistic dialogue containing a subtle manipulation tactic, without it being labeled as such
exercise.branching_choice: Student identifies whether something feels off, and if so, what specifically
exercise.practice: Socratic follow-up naming the specific tactic and why it works on people

assessment.success_marker: student names the specific tactic (not just 'that felt weird') and explains why it's persuasive
